_meta.what: components the 2 Oct master draws that v9.15 has no component for (ref -> [components], v9.15 schema)

frame.poly: MASTER_LOC.pt frame: fractions of the 17 Sep sheet (x / 2384, y / 1684, y down), the frame Arrange loads and the Map explorer draw in
frame.proof: U1: 51 tags, median residual 0.074 pt (0.05 m); live Arrange loads anchors 0 px
frame.to_sheet_points: multiply fx by 2384 and fy by 1684 before measuring angles or lengths (equal scale in x and y)
frame.outward: unit vector in sheet points (x east on the drawing, y down)
frame.angle_deg: long axis, 0 = drawing east (right), clockwise (y down), 0-180
frame.faces: compass direction of the door's outward side on the ground, from the explorer's satellite registration (drawing up = east)
